messages:
jordan_sales: FYI — NovaHealth (enterprise trial) is asking us to onboard an open med/NLU model called "medmod-v2" and pin it to eu-west-1. They want an LTS-INT8 quantized variant for cost reasons and an automatic fallback to "medmod-v1" if latency >200ms. Ticket: https://rwd.crm/NC-9842. Can product + eng triage?

lydia_product: Thanks Jordan — couple clarifying q's before triage: is this for hosted only or do they require Private (VPC/on-prem)? Any regulatory constraints (HIPAA-like) they flagged? Also need requested go-live date.

ollie_support: Copied from the customer email: "We need EU data residency, contractual controls for PHI-like data, throughput ~60 req/s with p99 latency goals, and support for seq_len up to 2048. Prefer hosted but contract team is pushing for Private if needed." They asked for GA availability by 2026-04-15.

rajesh_eng-ml: Noted. medmod-v2 isn't in our catalog yet. Quick technical notes: model appears RoBERTa-style encoder with ~3.2B params. Licensing looks permissive (MIT-ish) but we should verify repo checksum. For serving we need two variants: fp16 (baseline) and INT8 LTS. INT8 accuracy vs baseline needs validation on their eval set before we commit. Also need to confirm tokenizer compatibility.

sam_platform: From infra POV: if it's hosted + EU pin, we can route to eu-west-1 dedicated pool. Capacity note: fp16 instance ~40GB GPU usable; INT8 can fit in 12GB with kernel support. If they want 60 req/s with p50 <120ms we should reserve a small dedicated pool or autoscale policy. ETA depends on onboarding work — estimate 10 working days for catalog + region pin + perf runs if model weights are available and licensing is clear. Private deployment will add 2-3 weeks.

lydia_product: Proposed acceptance criteria for product sign-off (please comment):
1) Catalog entry created with model metadata, license, and owner.
2) EU-region staging validation: smoke + perf.
3) Perf SLOs validated on their sample eval set: p50 <120ms at 60 req/s on dedicated config; fallback policy triggers if p99 > 400ms.
4) Quality regression gate: <=1% absolute F1 drop vs customer baseline on their eval prompts.
5) Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback to medmod-v1 and metrics observability.
If everyone agrees, I'll create an intake ticket and mark as high-priority enterprise onboarding.

jordan_sales: Customer timeline is aggressive — 2026-04-15 is their ask. They'll accept hosted EU-only as long as contractual controls are in place. I'll push for confirming the eval set today.

infra_ops: cc @rajesh_eng-ml @sam_platform — kernel support check: medmod uses standard attention blocks but with fused layernorm variants. We need to confirm our INT8 kernels support that fused op, otherwise quantization pipeline might require a small compatibility shim. Also GPU memory estimates align with Sam's notes.

rajesh_eng-ml: I'll pull the repo, validate tokenizer, and run a small quantization test. Will post perf and quality numbers by EOD (ETA: +1 business day).

ollie_support: Customer shared a short eval set and a few sample prompts; pasting sanitized examples below for eng to run locally:

```
# sample eval prompts (sanitized)
1) "Summarize the patient's recent discharge notes focusing on medication changes."
2) "Extract all instances of drug names and dosages from the clinical note."
3) "Is there mention of an adverse reaction to medication X? If yes, list evidence."
```

lydia_product: Thanks, adding these to the intake. I'm creating INTAKE-4627 and assigning to @rajesh_eng-ml and @sam_platform. Labels: catalog:onboard, region:eu, priority:high, customer:NovaHealth. Jordan — please confirm hosted vs private and sign-off on the eval set by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: INTAKE-4627 created by lydia_product and assigned to rajesh_eng-ml, sam_platform. Link: https://rwd.internal/INTAKE-4627

jordan_sales: Pinged the customer — they confirmed hosted EU-only is acceptable if contractual controls are finalized. Will upload the full eval set once legal signs the NDA (expected by EOD).

sam_platform: OK — once rajesh posts perf numbers we'll open infra capacity request and reserve a dedicated pool for canary. If quantized INT8 passes quality gate, we can push an LTS pin for eu-west-1 within the 2-week optimistic path.

lydia_product: Great. Next steps: (1) @rajesh run quality + perf on provided eval prompts; (2) @sam prepare capacity estimate and autoscale policy; (3) @jordan confirm contract + upload eval set; (4) Product will create rollout playbook and acceptance checklist. I'll mark intake as P1 and sync in tomorrow's PM triage.

rajesh_eng-ml: On it — I'll post initial numbers here (quant perf + accuracy) by 1770002234.

sam_platform: adding a quick note: we'll likely need a small kernel tweak for fused layernorm — tagging eng-runtime if rajesh validates incompatibility.

lydia_product: Thanks everyone. If nothing else, I'll track updates in INTAKE-4627. :thumbsup:
